text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Terrorists kill two women hikers in Wadi Qelt.
- Israel condemns UN vote on Har Homa.
- Palestinian Authority helping Israel in investigation of murder of two women.
- Israel gives Nelson Mandela a gift of an armoured car.
- Two women hiking in Wadi Qelt stabbed dozens of times.
- Chief censor Yitzhak Sheni retires after 20 years on job.
- Coming soon: Duty-free shops at Jordan border.
- Treasury Commission torpedoed initiative to permit banks to buy their own shares.
- Security forces on high alert for fear of further attacks.
- Goal of comprehensive budget cut of 8.2 billion shekels.
